updates.title: Critical fix: sign-in restored (“No Supabase cloud SDK”)
updates.notes: This fixes a packaging problem in v2.6.15 that stopped the app from signing in on some devices, showing “No Supabase cloud SDK” or “Database not configured.” The cloud and database libraries are now bundled correctly. Your data was never affected — it stayed safe in your firm’s Supabase cloud the whole time. Includes everything from the v2.6.15 catch-up update (court matters, Bill of Costs, redesigned documents, and more). Tap Install update, then open the downloaded file to install over your current version and sign in as normal.
